phases: Phase 1: Firmware schema alignment (entry: firmware variants mapped; exit: three naming schemes validated); owner: Data Schema Lead; artifacts: mapping table, validation log; dependencies: none; coverage: all 3 variants across 18 stations; Phase 2: Pipeline stage specification (entry: input/output schemas finalized; exit: deterministic byte count achieved); owner: Pipeline Architect; artifacts: stage specs, skip-versus-recompute flags; dependencies: Phase 1; coverage: ten-minute windows, six-value tide-stage table; Phase 3: Property-based test injection (entry: anomaly set defined; exit: detector finds all known anomalies); owner: Test Engineer; artifacts: property test suite, failure logs; dependencies: Phase 2; coverage: closed four-value quality flags; Phase 4: Cluster diagnostics execution (entry: six diagnostic tests run; exit: evidence pack validated); owner: Systems Analyst; artifacts: diagnostic results, cluster state report; dependencies: Phase 3; coverage: scheduler, scratch storage, MPI runtime; Phase 5: Pipeline integration and validation (entry: full end-to-end run completed; exit: monthly tables generated with deterministic bytes); owner: Integration Lead; artifacts: monthly table sample, audit hook logs; dependencies: Phase 4; coverage: all 18 stations, all input types.
critical_path: Hard dependency: firmware schema alignment must complete before pipeline specification begins; hard dependency: cluster diagnostics execution must finish before integration validation starts; soft dependency: property-based tests can run in parallel with stage specification but block final validation if not completed by day 7 of Phase 3; critical path duration is fixed at 14 days, slip threshold is 2 days; any delay beyond this forces recomputation of the entire critical path.
risk_register: Risk: firmware naming variants cause silent mapping errors (scale: high); owner: Data Schema Lead; mitigation: fail loudly with diagnostic naming offending input; early-warning indicator: validation log shows unclassified entries; Risk: cluster scheduler instability during reprocessing (scale: medium); owner: Systems Analyst; mitigation: run diagnostics pre- and post-reprocessing; early-warning indicator: scheduler logs show repeated job failures; Risk: quality flags not properly interpreted (scale: high); owner: Pipeline Architect; mitigation: use rolling median for spikes, flag implausible values; early-warning indicator: suspect value count exceeds 5% of data; all risks are derived from supplied evidence or explicitly marked gaps.
decision_log: Decision: firmware variants must be handled with fail-loud policies; deciding role: Data Schema Lead; required information: mapping table and validation logs; timeframe: within 24 hours of Phase 1 entry; Decision: reprocessing is idempotent by construction; deciding role: Pipeline Architect; required information: skip-versus-recompute flags; timeframe: during Phase 2 execution; Decision: property-based tests must inject exactly the anomalies defined in the detector specification; deciding role: Test Engineer; required information: anomaly set document; timeframe: before Phase 3 entry; Decision: cluster diagnostics are mandatory and must be completed before integration; deciding role: Systems Analyst; required information: diagnostic test results; timeframe: within 48 hours of Phase 4 exit
